parameters.caption:
Epic synth-pop song, 115 BPM, A minor, 4/4. The song starts immediately with the female lead singing the first verse: "A blank screen waits, I draw a line". Vocals enter on the opening beat, with drums, bass and synths accompanying the singer from the start.

One expressive female vocalist with warm, clear English diction. Shimmering analog synths, flowing arpeggios, pulsing bass, punchy electronic drums and cinematic pads. Hopeful, adventurous and melodic. Prominent lead vocals, anthemic choruses, consistent vocal tone and smooth transitions.

Follow the supplied lyrics in order, beginning with Verse 1 and continuing through every section. Maintain a steady groove and finish with a short resolved ending.
parameters.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A blank screen waits, I draw a line
One little spark, a new design
I place a node and watch it grow
A world appears where colors flow

[Chorus - anthemic]
With Modly, we can make it real
A world to touch, a world to feel
We join the nodes and let them glow
And watch a new horizon grow

[Verse 2]
I shape the hills, you paint the sky
We set a little sun up high
I draw a road around the bend
You build a home for every friend

[Bridge]
Connect the dots and take my hand
There's room for all the worlds we planned

[Final Chorus - anthemic]
With Modly, we can make it real
A world to touch, a world to feel
We join the nodes and let them glow
And watch a new horizon grow

[Outro]
One little spark, a world awake
With Modly, these are worlds we make
